	public class SetTile : GenAction
	{
		private ushort _type;

		private bool _doFraming;

		private bool _doNeighborFraming;

		private bool _clearTile;

		public SetTile(ushort type, bool setSelfFrames = false, bool setNeighborFrames = true, bool clearTile = true)
		{
			_type = type;
			_doFraming = setSelfFrames;
			_doNeighborFraming = setNeighborFrames;
			_clearTile = clearTile;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
		{
			Tile tile = GenBase._tiles[x, y];
			if (_clearTile)
			{
				tile.Clear(~(TileDataType.Wiring | TileDataType.Actuator));
			}
			tile.type = _type;
			tile.active(active: true);
			if (_doFraming)
			{
				WorldUtils.TileFrame(x, y, _doNeighborFraming);
			}
			return UnitApply(origin, x, y, args);
		}
	}
	public class SetTileKeepWall : GenAction
	{
		private ushort _type;

		private bool _doFraming;

		private bool _doNeighborFraming;

		public SetTileKeepWall(ushort type, bool setSelfFrames = false, bool setNeighborFrames = true)
		{
			_type = type;
			_doFraming = setSelfFrames;
			_doNeighborFraming = setNeighborFrames;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
		{
			ushort wall = GenBase._tiles[x, y].wall;
			int wallFrameX = GenBase._tiles[x, y].wallFrameX();
			int wallFrameY = GenBase._tiles[x, y].wallFrameY();
			GenBase._tiles[x, y].Clear(~(TileDataType.Wiring | TileDataType.Actuator));
			GenBase._tiles[x, y].type = _type;
			GenBase._tiles[x, y].active(active: true);

 "old_string": "/** CheckAlch（cs:45981-46044，dispatch default 的 tileAlch 族 cs:86573）：\n *  下格 !nactive/半砖 → 杀；frameY 无条件复位 0；按 frameX/18 列查地基（lava 格恒杀）；\n *  列 5 含岩浆成熟转换（liquid>16 → 83↔84）。 */\nfunction checkAlchSweep(st: TileStore, ctx: SweepCtx, x: number, y: number): void {\n  const i = st.idx(x, y);\n  const isLava = st.liquid[i]! > 0 && st.liquidType[i] === LIQUID_TYPE.LAVA;\n  let bad = !nactiveAt(st, x, y + 1) || halfOf(st, x, y + 1);               // cs:45989-94\n  st.frameY[i] = 0;                                                          // 无条件复位（cs:45996）\n  const col = Math.trunc(st.frameX[i]! / 18);\n  if (!bad && !isLava) {\n    const g = ALCH_GROUND[col];\n    if (!g || !g.has(sheetAt2(st, x, y + 1))) bad = true;                    // 列 0-6 地基门\n  }\n  if (!bad && isLava) bad = true;                                            // 各 case 的 lava 门\n  if (col === 5 && !bad) {                                                   // cs:46025-42 成熟转换\n    if (st.liquid[i]! > 16) { if (st.type[i] === 82 || st.type[i] === 83) st.type[i] = 84; }\n    else if (st.type[i] === 84) st.type[i] = 83;\n  }\n  if (bad) killTileGen(st, ctx, x, y);\n}",
 "new_string": "/** CheckAlch（cs:45981-46044，dispatch default 的 tileAlch 族 cs:86573）：\n *  下格 !nactive/半砖 → 杀；frameY 无条件复位 0；switch 仅在头门通过时进入——\n *  按 frameX/18 列查地基（列外=无 case → 恒活）；lava 格恒杀；列 5 的成熟转换\n *  在 case 内部（进入 switch 即执行，不受中途 flag 影响）。 */\nfunction checkAlchSweep(st: TileStore, ctx: SweepCtx, x: number, y: number, sheet: number): void {\n  const i = st.idx(x, y);\n  const isLava = st.liquid[i]! > 0 && st.liquidType[i] === LIQUID_TYPE.LAVA;\n  let bad = !nactiveAt(st, x, y + 1) || halfOf(st, x, y + 1);               // cs:45989-94\n  st.frameY[i] = 0;                                                          // 无条件复位（cs:45996）\n  const col = Math.trunc(st.frameX[i]! / 18);\n  if (!bad) {                                                                // switch 进入门（cs:45997）\n    const g = ALCH_GROUND[col];\n    if (g) {                                                                 // 列 0-6；列外无 case\n      if (!g.has(sheetAt2(st, x, y + 1))) bad = true;\n      if (isLava) bad = true;                                                // 各 case 的 lava 门\n      if (col === 5) {                                                       // cs:46025-42 成熟转换\n        if (sheet !== 82 && isLava) {\n          if (st.liquid[i]! > 16) {\n            if (sheet === 83) st.type[i] = REV_SHEET_ID.get(84)!;\n          } else if (sheet === 84) st.type[i] = REV_SHEET_ID.get(83)!;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  if (bad) killTileGen(st, ctx, x, y);\n}"
}

    const m = src[l]!.match(/▶([^（(]+?)[（(\s]/);
    if (m) return m[1].trim();
  }
  return '';
}
